title: Lost Mary Maryliq Lemon Lime 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Experience all-day vaping satisfaction and flavour with Maryliq Nic Salts. Sharpen your senses and tantalise your tastebuds with Lost Mary Maryliq's Lemon Lime. This zippy, zesty blends marries the vibrant, tropical tang of fresh lime with the sharp, sunny sweetness of lemons for a magically Mediterranean experience and a taste as timeless as they come. Lemon Lime’s 50% VG / 50% PG ratio is perfectly balanced for a smooth throat hit and a flavourful cloud, making it a perfect all-day vape. Ideal for refillable vape UK and starter e-cigarette kit UK devices, giving reliable performance for everyday vaping.
